name: LatteGay: A Very Gay Coffee Shop Game
source:
LatteGay is a Gay™ visual novel about the trials and tribulations of working in a coffee shop. And dating your coworkers or customers. 

[From [url=https://huffleduck.itch.io/lattegay-demo]itch.io[/url]]

Made for Yuri Game Jam 2018.
translation:
LatteGay是一部Gay™ 视觉小说，讲述了在咖啡店工作的考验和磨难。并与你的同事或客户约会。

[来自[url=https://huffleduck.itch.io/lattegay-demo]itch.io[/url]]

专为Yuri Game Jam 2018制作。
